import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, capacity, reverse;
        Edge(int t, int c, int r) {
            to = t;
            capacity = c;
            reverse = r;
        }
    }

    static List<List<Edge>> graph;
    static int[] level;
    static int[] ptr;

    static void add_edge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, cap, graph.get(v).size()));
        graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, 0, graph.get(u).size() - 1));
    }

    static boolean bfs(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        level[s] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                if (e.capacity > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                    level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
        return level[t] != -1;
    }

    static int dfs(int u, int t, int flow) {
        if (u == t || flow == 0) return flow;
        for (int i = ptr[u]; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
            ptr[u] = i;
            Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
            if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity > 0) {
                int pushed = dfs(e.to, t, Math.min(flow, e.capacity));
                if (pushed > 0) {
                    e.capacity -= pushed;
                    graph.get(e.to).get(e.reverse).capacity += pushed;
                    return pushed;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int dinic(int s, int t) {
        int max_flow = 0;
        while (bfs(s, t)) {
            Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
            while (true) {
                int pushed = dfs(s, t, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                if (pushed == 0) break;
                max_flow += pushed;
            }
        }
        return max_flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        
        int dim = sc.nextInt();
        int time_to_die = sc.nextInt();
        
        int total_nodes = 2 * dim * dim + 2;
        graph = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < total_nodes; i++) {
            graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        level = new int[total_nodes];
        ptr = new int[total_nodes];
        
        String[] labsci = new String[dim];
        String[] labcap = new String[dim];
        
        int[][][] vert = new int[dim][dim][2];
        int malfunc = -1;
        
        int N = 2;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labsci[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = labsci[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int node = N++;
                    add_edge(0, node, c - '0');
                    vert[i][j][0] = node;
                } else if (c == 'Z') {
                    malfunc = 100 * i + j;
                    labsci[i] = labsci[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + labsci[i].substring(j + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        
        int M = N;
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            labcap[i] = sc.next();
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                char c = labcap[i].charAt(j);
                if (c >= '1' && c <= '9') {
                    int node = M++;
                    add_edge(node, 1, c - '0');
                    vert[i][j][1] = node;
                }
            }
        }
        
        int[][] die = new int[dim][dim];
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++)
                die[i][j] = time_to_die + 1;
        
        if (malfunc != -1) {
            die[malfunc / 100][malfunc % 100] = 0;
        }
        
        int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
        int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};
        
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        if (malfunc != -1) q.offer(malfunc);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int pos = q.poll();
            int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = x + dx[i], ny = y + dy[i];
                if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && 
                    labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && die[nx][ny] > die[x][y] + 1) {
                    die[nx][ny] = die[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < dim; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < dim; j++) {
                if (labsci[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labsci[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                    int[][] reach = new int[dim][dim];
                    for (int x = 0; x < dim; x++)
                        for (int y = 0; y < dim; y++)
                            reach[x][y] = time_to_die + 1;
                    reach[i][j] = 0;
                    
                    if (labcap[i].charAt(j) >= '1' && labcap[i].charAt(j) <= '9') {
                        add_edge(vert[i][j][0], vert[i][j][1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                    }
                    
                    Queue<Integer> qq = new LinkedList<>();
                    qq.offer(100 * i + j);
                    while (!qq.isEmpty()) {
                        int pos = qq.poll();
                        int x = pos / 100, y = pos % 100;
                        
                        for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                            int nx = x + dx[d], ny = y + dy[d];
                            if (nx >= 0 && nx < dim && ny >= 0 && ny < dim && 
                                labsci[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && reach[nx][ny] > reach[x][y] + 1) {
                                if (labcap[nx].charAt(ny) >= '1' && labcap[nx].charAt(ny) <= '9') {
                                    if (reach[x][y] + 1 <= die[nx][ny]) {
                                        add_edge(vert[i][j][0], vert[nx][ny][1], Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                                    }
                                }
                                if (reach[x][y] + 1 < die[nx][ny]) {
                                    reach[nx][ny] = reach[x][y] + 1;
                                    qq.offer(100 * nx + ny);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(dinic(0, 1));
    }
}
